issues.title: Beira Corridor expansion offers hope on fuel security for Southern Africa including Malawi
issues.title_en: Beira Corridor expansion offers hope on fuel security for Southern Africa including Malawi
issues.summary: * Discussions centred on expanding fuel transportation capacity, diversifying supply routes and strengthening the Beira Corridor’s role in supporting regional economic growth * Ongoing expansion of the Beira-Feruka pipeline is expected to increase its annual transportation capacity from three million to five million cubic metres by December 2027 By Winston Mwale, Africa Brief in Livingstone, Zambia Southern African countries have been urged to strengthen regional cooperation and invest in coordinated fuel infrastructure as growing petroleum demand places increasing pressure on supply networks serving Malawi, Zambia, Zimbabwe, Botswana and the Democratic...
